description: “VWETO III is intended for movement. It’s to be played when you birth yourself back outside after a long introspective period to get the things you need. It intends for you to be your own superhero and wants to be your theme for power.” Georgia Anne Muldrow
credits:
Produced, Written and Performed by Georgia Anne Muldrow.
Featuring guests Shana Jensen and Ayun Basa
